skill.summary: Analyzes profit margins by product/service, benchmarks against 2026 industry data, identifies margin erosion, and recommends pricing and cost optimizations.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Profit Margin Analyzer skill.

- Calculates gross, operating, and net margins by product/service line.
- Benchmarks your margins against 2026 industry standards.
- Identifies margin erosion sources and root causes.
- Provides actionable pricing improvement recommendations.
- Models profit impact of pricing and cost changes.
- Includes frameworks, practical checklists, and quick-win strategies for margin optimization.
